mechanics.claim: Rebirth triggers upon taking fatal damage, entering resurrection and restoring full health.
mechanics.quote: upon taking {{tip|death|fatal damage}}, '''Anivia''' enters {{tip|resurrection}} for 6 seconds and restores all of her {{sti|{{as|health}}}}

mechanics.claim: While resurrecting, Anivia is unable to act.
If Anivia survives the duration, she is revived with her current health, not full health.
mechanics.quote: she is revived with her {{as|'''current''' health}}

mechanics.claim: Guardian Angel and Chronoshift take priority over Rebirth.
mechanics.quote: {{ai|Chronoshift|Zilean}} and {{ii|Guardian Angel}} will take priority over ''Rebirth''.
